title: Storage and screen-heavy controls
summary: This topic combines sparse feedback about missing small-item storage with broader comments about screen-heavy electronic controls and explanations, so the sample is not coherent enough for a stronger single-theme conclusion.

positive.summary: The positive review praises having pockets to avoid dumping small items like umbrellas.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention overloaded screens and menus, laptop-like electronics, dealership or salesperson explanation needs, and some vague safety concerns without enough context for a firmer sentiment label.

limitations: Most examples are labeled undetermined, which limits clear sentiment interpretation.
The cluster mixes at least two subjects: cabin storage and broader electronics or infotainment usability.
Several fragments are too brief or vague to determine the exact feature being discussed or the reviewer’s overall stance.
The examples are insufficient to assess how consistently these comments reflect a single ownership issue.
